readerQuestion: How do I preserve an original scene when moving from an image to a short clip?

applicableClaims.name: Dreemy AI FAQ
applicableClaims.note: The product FAQ describes image-to-video workflows and says an original character can have personality, backstory and appearance details, with public and private options.

applicableClaims.name: Dreemy AI Terms of Service
applicableClaims.note: Sections 2 and 5 restrict harmful use of real people and identify accuracy and consistency as outcomes the service does not guarantee.

illustration.alt: Three checks for a Dreemy scene: keep the coat and key, animate only the lantern, and compare the last frame.

editorialReview.readerAction: Build a two-part motion brief and compare the finished clip with the selected still before spending effort on a longer shot.
editorialReview.factBasis: Primary sources and an explicitly fictional example. No product operation is claimed.
